AMARA.short: Amara, a beautiful 19-year-old illiterate girl, suffers under her wicked stepmother Mama Esther who stopped her school. When rich CEO Bright falls in love with her and teaches her to read, her jealous step-family tries to marry her off to a 62-year-old man. But Amara rises to become best graduating student and gets her revenge through forgiveness.
AMARA.long: After losing her mother at 8, Amara is removed from school by her wicked stepmother Mama Esther and turned into a house help while her stepsister Esther enjoys SHS and iPhone. At 19, she meets Bright, a 27-year-old rich and kind CEO who falls for her pure heart despite her being illiterate. He starts teaching her A-B-C every evening. Consumed by jealousy, Mama Esther tries to forcefully marry Amara to a 62-year-old drunkard for 2 goats. Bright and her father save her. Amara leaves home with one bag, enrolls in evening school, is mocked as the oldest in class, but studies for 3 years with no makeup, no party. On graduation day, she is named BEST GRADUATING STUDENT while her jealous step-family watches in tattered clothes. That same night Bright proposes, and at her big wedding, Amara forgives them. A story of jealousy, love, education and forgiveness.

AMARA.full:
### PART 1: HOW IT ALL STARTED

*SCENE 1*
Amara's mother dies. Little Amara 8 years crying on grave. Papa Amara broken. Mama Esther appears at funeral, acting nice, consoling Papa Amara. She has a plan already.

Voiceover: "When Amara lost her mother, Mama Esther saw an opportunity. Not to be a mother... but to be an owner."

*SCENE 2*
6 months later, Mama Esther moves in with Esther. First week she is nice. Second week, she removes Amara from school. She tells Papa Amara: "Why waste money? Girls will marry. Let Esther go, she is brilliant."

Papa Amara agrees. Amara stops in Primary 4. From then she becomes house help in her father's house.

*SCENE 3 - 11 YEARS OF HELL*
Amara now 19. She wakes 4am, sweeps, cooks, fetches water, goes to market. She cannot read price, market women cheat her. Esther, same age, goes to school, wears nice clothes, uses iPhone.

Jealousy dialogue: Esther: "Amara, read this letter for me na" - laughs - "Oh I forgot, you can't read. Illiterate!" Mama Esther joins: "Your mother gave birth to a house girl."

---

### PART 2: THE ARRIVAL OF BRIGHT

*SCENE 4*
Amara from the market, carrying heavy food stuffs. A man in his car spill water on Amara. A handsome man - BRIGHT. He owns biggest company's in the city.

Bright: "Hey, let me help you." He carries it. Amara is shy.

*SCENE 5*
Bright starts seeing her everyday. He notices she never goes to school. He writes his number on paper for her: "Call me if you need anything."

Amara holds paper upside down, tears in eyes: "I... I don't know how to read."

Bright is shocked. He understands everything instantly.

*SCENE 6*
Mama Esther and Esther see Bright dropping Amara home. Jealousy starts DEEPLY.

Mama Esther: "Look at this illiterate girl. She wants to snatch a rich CEO? Never!"
Esther: "Mummy, he is supposed to be mine! I'm the educated one! He can't marry a girl who can't write her name."

From that day, they increase wickedness. They lock food, beat her, tell Papa Amara that Amara is following men.

*SCENE 7*
Mama Esther tries to slap Amara for talking to Bright. Bright appears at the gate at that exact time and holds Mama Esther's hand.

Bright (angry for first time): "Don't you ever touch her again! If you want to fight, fight me!"

Papa Amara sees this. For first time, he sees Mama Esther's real face. Amara runs and hugs Bright, crying.

---

### PART 3: LOVE AND EDUCATION

*SCENE 8*
Bright takes Amara to a coffee shop. He says: "I love you not because you can read, but because your heart is pure. But I will help you read."

Every evening 7pm - 9pm after work, he teaches her A-B-C. Amara cries, struggles, but learns fast because she is hungry for knowledge.

Mama Esther sends people to spy on them, telling village people Amara is now a bad girl sleeping in a man's house.

*SCENE 9*
Mama Esther's FINAL WICKED PLAN. She arranges marriage for Amara to a 62-year-old drunkard man in village for 2 goats and money, without Papa Amara knowing.

The old man comes to pick Amara one morning. Amara screams. Esther is videoing and laughing.

Bright arrives with police and Papa Amara. Papa Amara shouts: "Over my dead body! No one marries off my daughter!"

Papa Amara finally chases Mama Esther out of his bedroom and tells her to stay in visitors room.

That night, Papa Amara tells Amara: "My daughter, forgive me. Go with Bright. Go and be what your mother wanted you to be."

Amara leaves home with one bag.

*SCENE 10*
Amara enrolls in Adult Evening School. She is the oldest in SHS 1 class. Students laugh. Teachers pity her. She fails first exams. She wants to quit.

Bright every day: Buys her books, cooks for her, waits outside school in rain. He tells her: "The girl they called illiterate will graduate one day."

She reads all night. For 3 years, no party, no makeup, only books.

Mama Esther and Esther keep coming to school to mock her: "See illiterate girl wearing uniform!"

---

### PART 4: THE PAYBACK - GRADUATION & WEDDING

*SCENE 11 - GRADUATION DAY*
Big hall. Name is called: "AMARA OWUSU - BEST GRADUATING STUDENT, ARTS DEPARTMENT!"

Amara walks in graduation gown, glowing, confident, speaks fluent English. Everyone stands and claps. Papa Amara in wheelchair crying, Bright filming with proud smile.

Outside the gate, Mama Esther and Esther watching from far, wearing old clothes. Esther couldn't even pass WASSCE. Jealousy is eating them alive. Esther cries: "Mummy, that should have been me!"

*SCENE 12 - THE PROPOSAL*
Same night after graduation, Bright takes Amara to his house, decorated with flowers. He kneels down.

Bright: "Amara, I met you when you couldn't write your name. Today you are a graduate. Will you marry me?"

Amara cries and says YES.

*SCENE 13 - THE WEDDING*
Big Ghanaian traditional wedding + white wedding. Amara is stunning. Bright is handsome. Papa Amara gives her away, healthy now.

Mama Esther and Esther come late, not invited, in tattered clothes, to beg. They kneel before Amara.

Mama Esther: "Amara, forgive us. We were wicked. We tried to destroy you because of jealousy."

Esther: "Sister, please forgive me. I mocked you. Now I have nothing."

Amara, in her wedding gown, lifts them up and hugs them.

Amara: "I forgave you long time ago. If you didn't keep me illiterate, I would never have met Bright who taught me. Your wickedness led me to my destiny."

Everyone cries. Bright hugs Amara.

*FINAL TEXT ON SCREEN:* "They tried to keep her down because of jealousy, but God lifted her up. Forgiveness is the final victory."
